description: Every propositional valuation determines an ultrafilter on formula classes, and each ultrafilter equals the filter of exactly one valuation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.valuationFilter_bijection.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] :
  (∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsUltrafilter
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.valuationFilter v)) ∧
    ∀ (F : Order.PFilter (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.FormulaAlgebra α)),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsUltrafilter F →
        ∃! v, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.valuationFilter v = F
